description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single hybrid ranged attacks (0.90/3.05 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Fire 3 with Stacking], [Zenith Mode], [Zenith Mode: Vincent (Fire)] and [Damage Cap +10000] to the user

description.name: Zenith Mode: Vincent (Fire)
description.text: Increases [Fire Infusion] damage bonus by 20%, cast speed x1.10 for PHY attacks and BLK, WHT, BLU, SUM or NAT attacks that deal magical damage, Fire abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Spirit Attack: Vincent after using three Fire abilities (max 1), maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Beast Flare+
description.text: Six single hybrid ranged attacks (1.20/1.25 or 3.80/3.95 each) capped at 9999/19999 after 0-2/3+ uses

description.name: Spirit Attack: Vincent
description.text: Causes [Imperil Fire 20% (5s)], grants [Buff Fire 20% (5s)] and [Quick Cast 2] to the user

description.name: Attach Fire 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
